capabilities: Insert clickable links to dropped files
Keep paths readable with spaces and parentheses
Copy files into the vault with Ctrl or Option
Embed images, audio, video, and PDFs when copying
disambiguation: Despite the name, it links to a file's existing location rather than copying dropped files into the vault.
extras: Desktop only; no file paths exist on mobile. Makes no network requests. Copy mode fails with 'Folder already exists' if the attachment folder name starts with a dot.
intentEvidence: as Obsidian does without the plugin
problem: Obsidian copies files dropped into a note into the vault, duplicating files that already exist elsewhere on the computer.
summary: Drag-and-drop plugin that inserts a clickable link to a file's existing location instead of copying it into the vault.
